value.cveTitle: Microsoft Office Visio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
value.description: Double free in Microsoft Office Visio allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
value.unformattedDescription: Double free in Microsoft Office Visio allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

articles.description:
How could an attacker exploit this vulnerability?

An unauthenticated attacker could send an email containing a specially crafted attachment to an affected Exchange server. The vulnerability is triggered when the server automatically processes the attachment for indexing; the recipient does not need to open the email or attachment. Successful exploitation could allow code execution with the permissions of the affected processing service.

articles.title: Microsoft Office Visio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
articles.description: Double free in Microsoft Office Visio allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

Is the Preview Pane an attack vector for this vulnerability?

No, the Preview Pane is not an attack vector.

value.cveTitle: Windows WebClient Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
value.description: Use after free in Windows WebClient Service allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.
value.unformattedDescription: Use after free in Windows WebClient Service allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

articles.title: Windows WebClient Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
articles.description: Use after free in Windows WebClient Service allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

What privileges could be gained by an attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability?

An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain SYSTEM privileges.

value.cveTitle: Windows Volume Manager Extension Driver Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
value.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Volume Manager Extension Driver allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
value.unformattedDescription: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Volume Manager Extension Driver allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

articles.description:
How could an attacker exploit this vulnerability?

An attacker could host a malicious server and convince a user to connect to it from an affected client. When the client processes the server's response, the attacker could execute code on the client system. User interaction is required.
